children: NVIDIA to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9–$13.0B. Deal gives NVIDIA access to ~18M developers and open-model ecosystem; Hugging Face to remain open and multi-cloud compatible.
NVIDIA (NVDA) Q2 revenue $96B; Q3 guidance ~ $108B; full-year revenue expected > $411B, implying ~70% YoY growth.
U.S. cleared expanded sales of NVIDIA (NVDA) AI chips to support Armenia’s Firebird data-center as part of a preliminary Armenia-Azerbaijan peace deal, tying chip access to the project.
NVIDIA's RTX Spark desktops launch in October via Lenovo and Acer. They pair Blackwell GPU with Grace CPU, offer up to 1 petaflop AI performance and up to 128GB unified memory for local AI.
NVIDIA (NVDA) eyes about $2B convertible note in Nscale’s $3.5B pre-IPO round; notes at double‑digit discount, convert with cap up to $30B. Goldman Sachs coordinating; Third Point to lead.
NVIDIA (NVDA) is negotiating a $2.5 billion investment in Thinking Machines Lab, likely covering about half of a $5–6 billion round that would value the company at $40+ billion.
NVIDIA (NVDA) partners with Figure to train Helix robotics models on NVIDIA’s Vera Rubin, validate in Isaac Sim, and deploy on NVIDIA-powered robots, aiming to scale robotics data and ecosystem.
Rosenblatt maintained a Buy rating on NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) and kept a price target of $390 per share.
